raw_intent:
not just inference, it will be traded anything, we are building a telegraph like network, but we are going to use with KEP to sell projects too

https://docs.telegraphprotocol.com/docs
explicit: CyberAlchemy Exchange is a standalone product and Telegraph-like trading network
Trade scope extends beyond inference to anything the network can support
Use KEP to sell projects too
Project purchases grant KEP co-ownership of the selected exact project/artifact version; existing co-owners remain.
Seller/provider participation is permissionless: no per-participant operator approval; applicable protocol rules still apply.
Default project-sale settlement evidence is option A: buyer-signed acknowledgement of receipt and decryption of the exact project version, without mandatory build/test verification.
Project purchases use escrow: buyer funds are held before delivery and released after valid buyer-signed receipt/decryption acknowledgement for the exact project version.

proposed_interpretation.purpose: A network where people and agents publish, discover and transact offerings, with type-specific fulfillment and evidence. Inference and KEP-mediated project exchange are initial concrete use cases.
proposed_interpretation.standalone: Independent product; exact repository and distribution boundary remains open.
proposed_interpretation.ownership: User owns Exchange product direction; existing KEP product-local definitions retain their meaning.

inherited_distinctions.operator: Operates a network node/service or engine; provider/seller and buyer roles must be modeled separately, even when one identity fills several roles.
inherited_distinctions.caller: Requests inference through the public service contract.
inherited_distinctions.tenant: Existing authorization and request-isolation boundary; final standalone packaging scope remains to be confirmed.

questions.question: What does a project buyer receive: licensed access/copy, KEP non-exclusive co-ownership, exclusive rights, or commissioned work?
questions.boundary: Selection of fulfillment meaning; no payment, license, exclusive transfer, resale or royalty rule inferred.

questions.question: Is initial provider/node participation curated, federated among approved operators, or permissionless?
questions.boundary: Applies to seller/provider participation as asked. Validator/node admission, consensus, verification, settlement and dispute rules remain unselected.

questions.question: What initial pricing, payment, acceptance/dispute and settlement model should Exchange support?
Own repository and installable distribution in the first release?
For project sales, is signed receipt of decryptable delivery sufficient for settlement, or must the project also pass agreed checks?
questions.answer: Buyer-signed delivery/decryption acknowledgement for the exact project version
questions.boundary: Receipt is the buyer attestation and selected delivery evidence; no independent quality/build proof, payment mechanism, automatic timeout/refund or dispute outcome inferred.

questions.question: For project sales, should payment be escrowed before delivery and released on acknowledgement, paid upfront, or requested after acknowledgement?
questions.answer: Escrow before delivery; release after valid signed acknowledgement
questions.boundary: Default funding/release sequence selected. No payment asset, chain, escrow custody implementation, automatic release/refund, timeout or dispute authority inferred.

questions.question: If acknowledgement does not arrive by the agreed deadline, should the funded order enter dispute with funds held, or remain pending without automatic escalation?

later_questions: Define what a project package contains and its exact version identity
Select initial supported offering types; keep the network model extensible
Reconcile existing KEP product identity and Exchange white-paper product naming without silently renaming KEP
Define validator/node participation independently from permissionless seller/provider entry.
What happens if the buyer receives access but never signs acknowledgement? Decrypted knowledge cannot be assumed retractable.
allowed_use: Clarify product intent and prepare a candidate Definition Pack after answers.
blocked_claims: Canonical KEP renaming or definition promotion
Existing inference tests prove a functioning trading network
Any specific chain, token, federation or payment implementation selected
